title: Biomes (data/biomes.json)
description: Look of each Grid sector. Floor patterns and environmental effects join in later phases.

color.description: Room color: block edges, walls and the floor grid inside the room.

look.description: Surroundings of the room (D62); every field is optional, with the Home Lattice look as the default (the ambience fields flows and panels default to off, D179).

background.description: The void behind everything; keep it near black. Default #05060d.

outerGrid.description: Floor grid outside the room; keep it dim, so it never reads as room. Default #2a2d35.

outerFade.description: Distance from the room (blocks) over which the outer grid fades out. Default 5.

wallGrid.description: Brightness of the faint grid on the back walls (share of the room color). Default 0.3.

flows.description: Data flows (D179): share of floor grid lines that now and then carry a bright dash. Default 0 (off).

panels.description: Glass panels (D179): share of the free back-wall cells (not the bottom row, not by a doorway) that become windows, picked anew on every entry. Default 0 (off).
